name: RS3
description: The Audi RS3 (2011–present) is the most extreme version of the A3, featuring a 2.5-litre five-cylinder turbocharged engine — the most powerful five-cylinder in production. The 8P/8V/8Y generations produced 340–400 hp with a distinctive five-cylinder howl that has become the RS3's sonic signature.
